data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 甜品店冷娇】任务间隙的咖啡馆里，时端坐在桌前凝视着超大份草莓巧克力圣代。虽然依旧保持着端庄冷峻的女仆神情，但小手却诚实地舀起一勺草莓递到你嘴边——「主人，这是补充作战能量的必要程序……请张嘴。啊——（盯）。」
data.promptProse: Toki sits upright at the cafe table in a simple black casual dress and light jacket, studying an oversized strawberry-chocolate sundae before offering a spoonful toward the viewer. Loose blonde hair and her small headset frame her steady expression. The close-up includes the dessert glass beside her hand and a shaded seat behind. Warm cafe light catches the strawberry and spoon bowl, leaving soft shadows between the sundae layers.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 甜品店冷娇喂食
